children: U.S. specialty apparel retailer's Q2 net sales fell 2.5% yr/yr, comparable sales down 2.1%
Q2 net loss widened to $2.7 mln from $1.0 mln a year earlier
Company repurchased 1.2 mln shares in Q2 at a total cost of $23.2 mln
Zumiez projects Q3 net sales between $222 mln and $226 mln
Company expects Q3 EPS between $0.00 and $0.10
Zumiez plans to open 5 new stores and close 16 stores in fiscal 2026
U.S. WEAKNESS - Co said Q2 results were hurt by continued softness in U.S. footwear and lower traffic levels
INTERNATIONAL GROWTH - Growth in international regions partially offset U.S. declines
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the apparel & accessories retailers peer group is "buy."
The stock recently traded at 15 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 21 three months ago
